top_strength: Jevic gathered comprehensive logistics details (7 of 7 items: property type, floors, distances, special features) and delivered both pricing anchors (typical time range and personalized estimate) with clear fee transparency and commitment framing, setting the customer up for confidence in the quote.
coaching_note: Never ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — you skipped Section 2 entirely and missed a critical concern (the 12 PM key access issue) that only surfaced during the booking window discussion, after pricing was locked; also skip the 'Does that feel fair?' silence and Section 6's final concerns check, leaving loose ends unconfirmed.
